verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch renewals, bulk updates or bulk data export, are a fair question for an IP registry service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents single-item flows: filing an application, searching by number, owner or keyword, renewing, updating or surrendering a trade mark. Nothing shows acting on many items at once, and the probe found the trade-mark search host walls automated agents at robots.txt.
